THE SOUTH’S MOST HONORED ARTISAN CHEESE

Out of Thomasville, Georgia, Sweet Grass Dairy makes some of the most decorated artisan cheese in the American South, led by Green Hill, a luscious double-cream with a soft bloomy rind that has become the creamery's calling card. Jessica Little grew up on a dairy, learning from her mother who helped pioneer artisan cheesemaking in the Southeast; she and her husband Jeremy have spent over two decades building on that foundation, earning more than 75 national and international honors from the American Cheese Society, the World Cheese Awards, and the Good Food Awards.

The range runs from Thomasville Tomme, aged 60 to 90 days in the style of a Pyrenees tomme, nutty and smooth, to Asher Blue, creamy enough to convert skeptics, to Georgia Gouda, a 2024 release that swept the major competitions in its first year. Sweet Grass Dairy's Southern cheese is shipped nationwide on Goldbelly, proof that the South belongs on any cheese board.

WE’RE NOT THE ONLY ONES WHO LOVE THEM!

From O, The Oprah Magazine to Garden & Gun to trade coverage in Grocery Dive, Sweet Grass Dairy has earned recognition across more than a decade of national and regional press.

On TV & Podcast: Food Quest on FYI (Season 2, Ep. 7), Georgia Public Broadcasting's A Fork in the Road, The Southern Fork (Ep. 51)

In Print: O, The Oprah Magazine; Food & Wine ("Georgia's Best Small Food Towns" + pimento cheese feature); Garden & Gun ("Get to Know These Southern Artisan Cheeses" + holiday cheeseboard); Southern Living 2016 Food Awards; The Atlanta Journal-Constitution (multiple features); culture: The Word on Cheese (Best Cheeses of the Year 2017 & 2025, "The Peach Cheese Plate," Georgia Gouda launch feature); Grocery Dive and Perishable News

Awards: Flavor of Georgia, Dairy Category Winner (2025); American Cheese Society, World Cheese Awards, and Good Food Awards — 50+ honors across Green Hill, Thomasville Tomme, Asher Blue, and Georgia Gouda; Southern Living 2016 Food Awards; Manufacturer of the Year, Thomasville-Thomas County (2018); Georgia Manufacturing Extension Partnership Faces of Manufacturing Award (2017); Georgia Small Business Rock Stars (2017)

A Southern creamery with a national reputation — and the hardware to prove it.

OUR CHEESE
GREEN HILL

Named after the first rotational-grazing dairy in our family, Green Hill is a crowd pleaser. This double cream, soft-ripened beauty is incredibly versatile with a wide range of pairing options. A Sweet Grass Dairy original, it has a subtle mushroomy flavor with a silky texture.

BUY ONLINE
OVERVIEW AWARDS PAIRINGS RECIPES
ASHER BLUE

Named after our Owners’ second son, Asher Blue has a natural rind and a creamy yet crumbly texture. This mild, raw milk blue has an earthy flavor with mild noted of cocoa on the finish.

BUY ONLINE
OVERVIEW AWARDS PAIRINGS RECIPES
THOMASVILLE TOMME

A farmhouse table cheese named for our hometown, made in the style of a French (Pyrenees) Mountain Tomme. Released between 60-90 days, it is naturally rinded with a semi-soft texture and subtle grassy flavors.

BUY ONLINE
OVERVIEW AWARDS PAIRINGS RECIPES
LIL' MOO ORIGINAL

A fresh spreadable cow's milk cheese that can be used in a wide range of sweet and savory recipe applications. Similar to cream cheese, our Lil' Moo is a 100% clean product made with whole milk instead of cream for a lighter texture and more tangy profile.

OVERVIEW AWARDS PAIRINGS RECIPES
PIMENTO

Pimento Cheese has been a magical comfort food for over a century in the South. Our Pimento Cheese is a unique adaptation of the classic recipe which includes our very own Thomasville Tomme, mayonnaise, piquillo pepper, and pimentón from Spain. This Southern classic has a slightly spicy, smokey flavor and a creamy, spreadable texture.

BUY ONLINE
OVERVIEW AWARDS PAIRINGS RECIPES
GRIFFIN

Named after our Owners’ third son, Griffin is a farm-style cheese whose curds have been soaked in an entire half barrel of Terminus Porter from Gate City Brewing. Aged a minimum of 120 days, Griffin has a crumbly texture and malty flavors.

BUY ONLINE
OVERVIEW AWARDS PAIRINGS RECIPES
GEORGIA GOUDA

Georgia Gouda is our take on a young Gouda that is aged for a minimum of 60 days. It has a rich yellow color with a smooth texture that lends well to melting. The flavor starts with a tanginess that gives way to a sweet and buttery finish.

BUY ONLINE
OVERVIEW AWARDS PAIRINGS RECIPES
CYPRESS

Cypress is a Mediterranean-inspired cheese flavored with a variety of olives, Calabrian chilis, basil, tomato, and dill. This pasteurized cheese has a semi-firm texture and herbaceous finish.

BUY ONLINE
OVERVIEW AWARDS PAIRINGS RECIPES
HEAT

Heat is a mildly spicy cheese with Southwestern flavors of chile, smoked Spanish paprika, and a variety of other herbs and spices. This pasteurized cheese has a semi-firm texture and a colorful interior and exterior.

BUY ONLINE
OVERVIEW AWARDS PAIRINGS RECIPES

We love Thomasville, GA so much we put a Cheese Shop in the heart of it. Started in 2010, this evolving venture is our opportunity to share the best of Sweet Grass Dairy with you. We extend the invitation to our farm table to enjoy our cheeses, favorite accompaniments and southern hospitality. We believe that every product has a story and we offer products selected with intention. We present an ever-changing menu with a variety of options to suit all of your needs. A small sampling of our menu includes handcrafted cheese and charcuterie boards, hand crafted sandwiches, salads, small plates, and desserts. We also offer well thought out liquor drinks focusing on field-to-flask and interesting local favorites. In addition, we have 8 taps to bring you the best of small batch brews. 

This deliberate approach gives us the ability to provide the finest customer service in a comfortable environment where quality and thoughtfulness are emphasized. 

Bring in a group of friends, kick your date off to a good start, or come in solo to grab a pint of craft beer. No matter who you are or why you're coming, we promise to provide an experience that feels like hanging out with your favorite people, enjoying great food.

VARIOUS POLICIES

Shipping Policy

Thank you for your consideration in purchasing our handcrafted cheeses. We want to ensure that when you purchase our products, you have the best experience possible.  For our perishable products to arrive in great condition, we can only ship Monday - Thursday depending on transit time.  We do not ship over the weekend.   

**Shipping times may be adjusted during peak times, holidays, or natural disasters.**

Orders placed on Monday or Tuesday by 2 PM ET will arrive the same week.
Orders placed Wednesday by 2 PM ET will arrive by Friday if;
Two Day Select or Next day Air is the shipping method chosen by the customer. 
If the delivery is within a ground shipping area with a time in transit of 2 days or less. 
Most southeastern states qualify for ground shipping sent within 1-2 business days.
Orders placed Thursday by 2 PM ET will arrive Friday if;
Next Day Air is selected by the customer
If  the delivery is within a ground shipping area for time in transit of one day.
Orders placed Friday – Sunday will be shipped and delivered the following week.  
If you place an order on Wednesday, unless you specify overnight delivery or you are in a one day ground shipping zone, your order will not be shipped until the following week.

PRIVACY POLICY

This Privacy Policy governs the manner in which Sweet Grass Dairy collects, uses, maintains and discloses information collected from users (each, a "User") of the https://www.SweetGrassDairy.com/ website ("Site"). This privacy policy applies to the Site and all products and services offered by Sweet Grass Dairy.

Personal identification information
We may collect personal identification information from Users in a variety of ways, including, but not limited to, when Users visit our site and in connection with other activities, services, features or resources we make available on our Site. Users may be asked for, as appropriate, name, email address, mailing address, phone number, credit card information,

Users may, however, visit our Site anonymously.

We will collect personal identification information from Users only if they voluntarily submit such information to us. Users can always refuse to supply personally identification information, except that it may prevent them from engaging in certain Site related activities.

Non-personal identification information
We may collect non-personal identification information about Users whenever they interact with our Site. Non-personal identification information may include the browser name, the type of computer and technical information about Users means of connection to our Site, such as the operating system and the Internet service providers utilized and other similar information.

Web browser cookies
Our Site may use "cookies" to enhance User experience. User's web browser places cookies on their hard drive for record-keeping purposes and sometimes to track information about them. User may choose to set their web browser to refuse cookies, or to alert you when cookies are being sent. If they do so, note that some parts of the Site may not function properly. 

How we use collected information
Sweet Grass Dairy collects and uses Users personal information for the following purposes:

To improve customer service
Your information helps us to more effectively respond to your customer service requests and support needs.
To personalize user experience
We may use information in the aggregate to understand how our Users as a group use the services and resources provided on our Site.
To improve our Site
We continually strive to improve our website offerings based on the information and feedback we receive from you.
To process transactions
We may use the information Users provide about themselves when placing an order only to provide service to that order. We do not share this information with outside parties except to the extent necessary to provide the service.
To send periodic emails
If User decides to opt-in to our mailing list, they will receive emails that may include company news, updates, related product or service information, etc. If at any time the User would like to unsubscribe from receiving future emails, we include detailed unsubscribe instructions at the bottom of each email or User may contact us via our Site.

How we protect your information
We adopt appropriate data collection, storage and processing practices and security measures to protect against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure or destruction of your personal information, username, password, transaction information and data stored on our Site.

Sensitive and private data exchange between the Site and its Users happens over a SSL secured communication channel and is encrypted and protected with digital signatures. 

Sharing your personal information
We do not sell, trade, or rent Users personal identification information to others. We may share generic aggregated demographic information not linked to any personal identification information regarding visitors and users with our business partners, trusted affiliates and advertisers for the purposes outlined above. We may use third party service providers to help us operate our business and the Site or administer activities on our behalf, such as sending out newsletters or surveys. We may share your information with these third parties for those limited purposes provided that you have given us your permission.

Changes to this privacy policy
Sweet Grass Dairy has the discretion to update this privacy policy at any time. When we do, revise the updated date at the bottom of this page. We encourage Users to frequently check this page for any changes to stay informed about how we are helping to protect the personal information we collect. You acknowledge and agree that it is your responsibility to review this privacy policy periodically and become aware of modifications.

Your acceptance of these terms
By using this Site, you signify your acceptance of this policy and terms of service. If you do not agree to this policy, please do not use our Site. Your continued use of the Site following the posting of changes to this policy will be deemed your acceptance of those changes.

Return Policy

We are always striving to bring the best tasting products to you, your family, or your friend's table.   We will do our best to ensure the cheese arrives in a timely manner and in great condition.  Since we’re shipping a perishable product, we encourage you to let the recipient know so that they can be on the lookout for a package. Also, we recommend that you track the shipments yourself and follow up to confirm that the package has been received.  If you’re unsatisfied, please reach out and give us clear details on the problem so we can refund or replace your order and improve our processes for future deliveries.  

We are not responsible for spoiled or damaged products for the following:

Incorrect addresses and/or missing apartment numbers, suites, etc.
Gifts that are sent to recipients who are out of town or unable to receive.
Gifts sent to businesses when closed.
